lessons.keep: Move from a specific hidden fault to the wider system that must manage it.
lessons.avoid: Avoid making illustrative location overlays stand in for measured detection and response.
lessons.open: Sensor method, detection accuracy, actual deployment, maintenance response, cost claim, image provenance and audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Show one Tin campaign issue inside a creative, then its campaign card and portfolio alert with the same ID.
Add a short real detection timeline with alert, assigned owner and confirmed fix before the broad portfolio shot.

comparison.story: Introduce an unseen building risk. → Make hidden infrastructure visible. → Locate the problem within a property. → Scale from one fault to portfolio monitoring. → Broaden the addressable property types. → Close on action and product purpose.
comparison.motion: Successive views move inward from building to pipe, then outward to building and portfolio; exact continuous camera paths are not established by samples. Sampling scope: 1 fps unless a closer window is recorded.
